articles.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
articles.snippet: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

articles.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
articles.snippet: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

articles.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
articles.snippet: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

articles.title: Europol Traces $28M in Crypto Behind Europe's Illegal Streaming Industry
articles.snippet: Police from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to follow crypto payments made to pirate TV services.

articles.title: CertiK Trains Interpol Investigators to Trace and Freeze Stolen Crypto
articles.snippet: The blockchain security firm walked officers from across Asia and the South Pacific through a real wallet-theft case at a workshop in Hanoi.
